summary: The shipped menu dataset contains 15 illustrative venues and 45 unverified dishes. None is a verified dietary recommendation. Verified mode excludes these records. Demonstration mode is opt-in and never establishes dietary suitability.
notCovered: Individual source-reviewed dishes, ingredients, allergen guarantees, holiday exceptions, temporary closures and a comprehensive HKU stall inventory are not yet covered.

It does not establish individual dish names, prices or allergen safety; no dishes have been invented from this description.
